================================================================================
Plain: no block comments
================================================================================

select 1 /* a; */ -- b;
;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement
    (comment)))

================================================================================
Plain: dollar signs and backticks are text
================================================================================

select $$a;b$$, `c;d`;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))
